experimental_method: Densities of concentrated solutions by two 50 ml Ostwald pycnometers (concentrations checked conductimetrically); apparent molar volumes of very dilute solutions from volume changes on dilution in a magnetically operated dilatometer; 25 C.
uncertainties_stated: Duplicate densities agree to 3 parts in 1e5 g/ml; temperature control better than 0.0001 C peak-to-trough (estimated); KCl tests agree to 0.02 ml/mole with Geffcken and Price; conductimetric and weight concentrations agree within 0.02 % (KNO3).
quality_remarks: phi_V values in Tables 1 and 2 are the author's calculations from measured densities or volume changes; the author notes only limited agreement for MgCl2 and CaCl2 with Shedlovsky and Brown at low concentration. LaCl3 used without further purification. Temperature scale not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table 3 (limiting apparent molar volumes at infinite dilution and ionic values; obtained by extrapolation, derived)
